title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding + closures: guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope, LOSSLESS approval identity (category + canonical text + scope fingerprint; NFC/whitespace only; no folding, sorting or symbol stripping)
description: P18.6 LOSSLESS-IDENTITY closure on base cabd25d - final approval-identity correction. Even canonical-statement keys still lost semantics: Vietnamese diacritic stripping merged DISTINCT words (bán vs bàn), punctuation/symbol removal merged currencies ($500 vs €500), dimensions (5% vs 5) and identifiers (C++ vs C#), case folding merged case-sensitive identifiers (US vs us). Replaced with a LOSSLESS fingerprint: issueKeyFor = category + canonical scope lineage (b/o/w/p, ''-normalized, unknown never silently matches) + canonical issue text where canonicalization is ONLY Unicode NFC + whitespace collapse/trim - no lowercase, no diacritic folding, no punctuation/symbol stripping, no token sorting, no stopword removal, no fuzzy matching. Identical issues under identical scope reuse approval (idempotent retries intact); anything not byte-identical requires fresh owner review - paraphrase similarity is never approval evidence. Coverage threads the confirmed revision's analysis scope into issueCoveredBy so cross-scope reviews never cover. Stored approvals with previous key formats fail re-proof closed (no silent migration; resolutions verify re-derives keys against pinned analysis). Adversarial probes: diacritic (bán/bàn, không/khong), currency ($/€/£), dimension (5%/5, 10°C/10C), identifier (C++/C#, node.js), case (US/us, API/api), scope lineage - plus approve->amend->re-preview->confirm positive (whitespace-variant reuse) and negative E2E over the real seam. Prior closures unchanged. Baseline: interpretation ADVISORY only; OFF default; no auto-merge.
